meta.name: comment-mining
meta.description: Use when the user wants to mine comments and replies for audience reactions, customer language, questions, objections, complaints, product ideas, buying intent, sentiment, or voice-of-customer insights from public social posts and videos.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从公开评论中提炼受众反应与产品洞见
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从社交评论中了解用户真实想法。
copy.tagline_en: Mine public comments for audience insights and customer voice.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand customer reactions from social comments.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从你提供的公开帖子/视频链接抓取评论,去掉明显垃圾与重复后,按问题、抱怨、购买意图等类别分类,归纳主题,并产出 Markdown 报告:含摘要、主题表、原文引用、内容创意等。
howto.when: 当你要求分析公开帖/视频下的评论,或从中找出问题、异议、购买意图等时触发;支持 TikTok、YouTube、Instagram 等平台。

say.text: 分析这条 YouTube 视频的评论,找出观众的常见痛点。
say.note: 会生成主题表与代表引用

say.text: 把这篇 Reddit 帖子下的评论按购买意向和异议分类。
从这条 TikTok 评论里挖购买信号和内容选题。

howto.what_en: After installation, fetches public comments from a post/video URL, filters spam/duplicates, categorizes comments, and writes a Markdown report with summary, themes, exact quotes, and content ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze comments on a public post/video, or to find questions, objections, buying intent, etc. Supported platforms include TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and others.

say_en.text: Analyze this YouTube video's comments for common audience pain points.
say_en.note: Generates a theme table with representative quotes.

say_en.text: Sort this Reddit post's comments by buying intent and objections.
Mine buying signals and content ideas from this TikTok's comments.
say_en.note: Output includes exact quotes to reuse.
